description_en: Initiates the third-party channel QR code configuration process in batches for specified cloud desktop runtimes, generates QR code configuration page URLs, and notifies the authorized users of the runtimes by email and SMS
description_zh: 批量为指定的云电脑Runtime发起三方通道扫码配置流程，生成扫码配置页面地址并通过邮件和短信通知Runtime的授权用户
kebab_example: aliyun appstream-center send-runtime-qr-code-config-channel-message --runtime-type CloudDesktop --runtime-ids ecd-xgads --agent-platform ENTERPRISE --agent-provider OpenClaw --code feishu --api-version 2021-09-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SendRuntimeQrCodeConfigChannelMessage

parameters.help_en: The runtime environment type of the runtime resource. Currently, only CloudDesktop is supported
parameters.help_zh: Runtime资源运行环境类型。当前仅支持 CloudDesktop（云电脑）
parameters.name: runtime_type

parameters.help_en: The list of runtime resource IDs, such as cloud desktop IDs. You can specify 1 to 200 IDs
parameters.help_zh: 运行资源ID列表，例如云电脑ID列表。最少 1 个，最多 200 个
parameters.name: runtime_ids

parameters.help_en: The third-party channel code, such as dingtalk-connector (DingTalk), feishu (Lark), or wecom (WeCom). If the current agent platform and provider do not support the channel, the error code ChannelConfig.NotSupported is returned, and no messages are sent
parameters.help_zh: 三方通道编码，例如 dingtalk-connector（钉钉）、feishu（飞书）、wecom（企业微信）。当前 Agent 平台与提供商不支持该通道时，返回错误码 ChannelConfig.NotSupported，且不会发送任何消息
parameters.name: code

schema.description_en: The response for sending QR code configuration channel messages in batches
schema.description_zh: 批量发送扫码配置通道消息的返回结果

Data.description_en: The list of sending results for each runtime. Each runtime corresponds to one result. The return order is not guaranteed to be the same as the order of RuntimeIds in the request. Match the results by RuntimeId
Data.description_zh: 各Runtime的发送结果列表，每个Runtime对应一条结果。返回顺序不保证与请求中RuntimeIds的顺序一致，请通过RuntimeId匹配

Code.description_en: The error code when the sending fails, such as Runtime.NotFound (the runtime does not exist) or Runtime.UserNotSupported (the runtime has no authorized users or has multiple authorized users). This parameter is not returned when the sending is successful
Code.description_zh: 发送失败时的错误码，例如 Runtime.NotFound（Runtime不存在）、Runtime.UserNotSupported（Runtime没有授权用户或存在多个授权用户）。发送成功时不返回

Message.description_en: The error message when the sending fails. This parameter is not returned when the sending is successful
Message.description_zh: 发送失败时的错误描述。发送成功时不返回

QrCodeNotifyUrl.description_en: The access URL of the QR code configuration channel page. It carries the taskId, channel code, and region parameters for the current process, and has been sent to the authorized user of the runtime by email and SMS. This parameter is returned only when the sending is successful. The taskId is valid for 1 hour
QrCodeNotifyUrl.description_zh: 扫码配置通道页面的访问地址，携带本次流程的 taskId、通道编码 code 和地域 region 参数，并已通过邮件和短信发送给Runtime的授权用户。仅在发送成功时返回，taskId 有效期为 1 小时

RuntimeId.description_en: The ID of the runtime resource

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the QR code configuration channel message for the runtime was initiated successfully. If the value is false, you can check the Code and Message fields for the cause of the failure
Success.description_zh: 该Runtime的扫码配置通道消息是否发起成功。取值为 false 时，可通过 Code 和 Message 查看失败原因

RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，用于标识请求的唯一 ID
RequestId.title_en: 请求ID，用于标识请求的唯一 ID
RequestId.title_zh: 请求ID，用于标识请求的唯一 ID

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of returned sending results, which is the same as the number of results in Data
TotalCount.description_zh: 返回的发送结果总数，与 Data 中的结果条数一致
